claims: Chuck Norris was known to be a member of the Prestonwood Baptist Church in Dallas, Texas.
Chuck Norris described himself as having a personal relationship with Jesus Christ.
Chuck Norris described his personal relationship with Jesus Christ as a daily lifestyle rather than just a religion.
Chuck Norris credited his mother for instilling his faith early in life.
Chuck Norris admitted to drifting from the Lord at certain points in his life.
Chuck Norris later returned to his faith.
Chuck Norris stated that 'the Lord never drifted from me'.
Chuck Norris has written several Christian-themed books and columns.
